verdict.rationale: Foreloop runs its own agents, such as the intention agent that reads feedback submissions and proposes tasks, so letting users plug in external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. The only MCP mention ([foreloop-docs-28]) describes the server direction: external agents use Foreloop's MCP to read and update Foreloop. Nothing in the evidence shows Foreloop connecting to or consuming tools from user-supplied MCP servers.
